title: BLACKPINK Reunites for a Bathroom Selfie at the 2026 Met Gala
summary: The ladies walked the carpet separately, but joined forces once inside.
contentText:
BLACKPINK momentarily shut down the ladies’ bathroom at the 2026 Met Gala, with JISOO, ROSÉ, JENNIE and LISA coming together to snap a sweet photo together over a sink at the event.

Posted by the Boyfriend on Demand star on Instagram late Wednesday (May 6) — two days after the iconic annual gala took place at the Metropolitan Museum of Art in New York City — the snap shows JISOO sticking out her tongue and holding up her phone to the bathroom mirror as ROSÉ makes a silly expression next to her. JENNIE does a cute duck face while LISA smiles from ear to ear, her eyes closed.

Gracie Abrams also appears in the background of the photo, under which ROSÉ commented a bunch of heart and tongue-out emojis.

The ladies of BLACKPINK each walked the Met carpet separately , allowing all four of them to properly show off their thematic gowns. This year’s dress code was “Fashion Is Art” supporting the costume institute’s new “Costume Art” exhibit. Perhaps the most elaborate of the K-pop group’s looks was LISA’s, with the White Lotus alum modeling a set of life-size fake arms on her shoulders (not pictured in the bathroom selfie).

The quartet is fresh off of the release of EP Deadline , which dropped in February and reached No. 8 on the Billboard 200 . In January, BLACKPINK wrapped its global Deadline World Tour, the trek marking the members’ grand reunion after spending about a year pursuing solo projects.

It’s unknown what will come next for the group, but JISOO recently teased that she’s hard at work on her upcoming debut solo album. “I’m working on showing a wider range of music,” she told V Magazine in a Wednesday (May 6) cover story. “I think I’d be really happy if people listen to this album and say they discovered a new side of me.”
